show_cart: Keep off: the site doesn't sell online, so there is no cart.
show_country: Shows only when the store sells to more than one country or region.
show_language: Shows only when the store has more than one language.
ts_style: **Technical** gives the thin, see-through bar with a line under it and the compact menu. Keep it: the Tangent design depends on it.
enable_sticky_header: **Always** keeps the header at the top of the screen while visitors scroll.
